scope: adds firmware/platform information to the development-mechanism comparison; not a new independent case analysis

new_mechanism.name: firmware record acceptance under versioned capability and scoped compatibility policy, with a qualified provider of the scope condition
new_mechanism.relation: acceptance follows the table's capability version; a compatibility relaxation applies exactly within its intended scope; the provider of the scope condition (environment classification) must cover that scope; early platform judgements must not shrink a domain they do not apply to
new_mechanism.specialized_facts: firmware table headers/versions, record flags, hypervisor identification line and boot parameters, possible/present/online, QMP hotplug replies and kernel hotplug messages
explicit_applicability_conditions: scope-condition provider (identified hypervisor type, KVM_GUEST, nopv)

cannot_borrow_from.CPU source-qualified export: a purpose-qualified data source does not qualify the provider of a policy condition
cannot_borrow_from.CPU identity/range: identity/count relations assume the accepted set; they do not say which firmware records should be accepted
cannot_borrow_from.virtio DMA buffer: a backend/coherency branch selection is configuration-bound; environment classification is runtime-detected and parameter-controllable

evidence_tiers_reached: real kernel with real QEMU firmware in real KVM/TCG environments plus QMP hotplug
open: Xen PV/HVM runtime (not feasible on this host)

cross_mechanism_observation: source qualification now appears at two levels: qualification of a data source for a purpose (CPU export) and qualification of the provider of a policy's scope condition (ACPI environment classification); configuration- or environment-dependent branch selection recurs across CPU identity (cpumask width), virtio (coherency/backend) and firmware (capability version, hypervisor type) and must be bound to the concrete configuration or runtime environment
manual: specification vs compatibility policy vs implementation fact
